Shri D.S. Niranjan - Advocate for the applicant through Vide
 Conferencing.
Ms. Geeta Yadav - Ga for the State.

Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 984/2023 dated 10.12.2023 registered at Police Station Kolar Road, Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366,
376(3), 376(2)(N), 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 3/4, 5(L)/6, 5(j)(ii) of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

The statement of the victim has been recorded before the trial Court and a perusal of the same palpably reflects that the victim was in relationship with the applicant and they were in touch for the last 3-4 years and used to like each other.
They were also willing to enter into wedlock.
It is submitted that the applicant is a young boy of 19 years of age.
His past record is unblemished.
He is in custody since NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12000 2 MCRC-9031-2025 14.2.2024 and therefore, no more required for custodial interrogation.
Trial will take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be released on bail.
3. Per contra, counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that the offence has been committed with the minor girl, therefore, no case for bail is made out to the applicant.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

5. Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, period of custody of the applicant and statement of the prosecutrix recorded before the trial Court, this Court deems it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
